schematic.document: HanRun HR911105A single port RJ45 with integrated magnetics, REV. A/2, served by LCSC for C12074
schematic.shows: HanRun's electrical specification and internal schematic: operating range 0 to +70 degC, isolation 1500 Vrms 0.5 mA 60 s UTP side to chip side, P1 TD+, P2 TD-, P3 RD+, P6 RD-, P4 and P5 the centre taps, P7 NC, P8 CHS GND with the note 'Connect CHS GND to PCB Ground', and the 4 x 75 ohm plus 1000 pF 2 kV termination inside the jack
